interfaces.name: package_outline
interfaces.package: UFQFPN-32 5x5x0.55 (active) — one of three, see below
interfaces.what: THREE PACKAGES SHIP AND THE DESIGN DOES NOT SAY WHICH — and all three now carry their own mechanical data instead of a product-page string. body_mm on this row is the ACTIVE 32-pin UFQFPN at its TYP: 5.0000 x 5.0000 x 0.5500 mm, D and E each 4.900-5.100, overall height A 0.500-0.600, lead pitch e 0.5000, lead width b 0.180-0.300, lead length L 0.300-0.500, exposed die pad D2 x E2 3.400-3.600 square, coplanarity ddd 0.080 MAX, standoff A1 0.000-0.050. Mould protrusion is EXCLUDED from D and E by the table's own note and may add up to 0.1500 mm, so 5.2500 mm is the envelope an enclosure must clear. The NRND VFQFPN32 shares the 5.000 x 5.000 footprint and the 3.500 exposed pad at 0.800-1.000 mm tall; the WLCSP36 is a different part geometrically, 3.213 x 3.203 mm at 0.550-0.630 mm on a 0.5000 mm ball pitch. WHICH ONE THE MICRODUCK USES IS STILL CANNOT DETERMINE: the board that carries it is unpublished. What settles it is a photograph or a BOM line for the board — a 5 mm square QFN and a 3.2 mm CSP are told apart by eye. The frame is the package's geometric centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane, +z into the body). `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN MECHANICAL DRAWINGS: STMicroelectronics ST25R3916/7 datasheet DS12484 Rev 8 (May 2023), section 6 'Package information' — 6.1 VFQFPN32 (Figure 36 outline p.150, Table 134 mechanical data pp.150-151), 6.2 UFQFPN32 (Figure 38 outline p.152, Table 135 mechanical data p.153, Figure 39 footprint example p.153), 6.3 WLCSP36 (Figure 40 outline p.154, Table 136 mechanical data p.155), of 160 pages — the copy in this folder (../../../datasheet.pdf, sha256 1170f4d74ff501917262ae42bf81c60c38c11d121e2ea2af6b1e845433befef1 in the folder's PROVENANCE.json, re-fetched 2026-09-03 from https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/st25r3916.pdf and byte-identical), read 2026-09-03 (lane T). SUPERSEDES the row published 2026-09-02, which cited the ST PRODUCT PAGE package list and said the land pattern would need 'the mechanical drawing in the ST25R3916 datasheet's package-information section'. That section was already in this folder, on pages 150-155 of the datasheet.pdf PROVENANCE.json had hashed. No dimension is contradicted — 5x5x0.55 is the drawing's TYP — but every number now carries min/typ/max, the exposed pad and the lead geometry are measured where before there were none, and the drawing's own note that D and E EXCLUDE up to 0.1500 mm of mould protrusion is recorded, which no product-page string carries.
interfaces.body_mm_basis: Table 135 'UFQFPN32 mechanical data', millimetres column, verbatim: D 4.900 / 5.000 / 5.100 min-typ-max, E 4.900 / 5.000 / 5.100, A 0.500 / 0.550 / 0.600. body_mm carries the TYP; the min and max are in packages_measured below. Table note 2: 'Dimensions D and E do not include mold protrusion, not to exceed 0.15 mm' — so the worst case an enclosure must clear is 5.100 + 0.15 = 5.2500 mm, not 5.1000.

interfaces.why: the first of the two single-ended antenna drives the sheet names ('Possibility to drive two independent single ended antennas', p.1).
